senses.gloss: a prefix (a compound of <cite ref="E00005"><he>הָא</he></cite> a. <he>ד־</he>), pl. <cite ref="E00112"><he>הֲדֵי</he></cite>,
with prefix ב and suffix of personal pronoun: בַּהֲדִי, בַּהֲדָאִי; בַּהֲדָךְ; בַּהֲדֵיה; בַּהֲדָן, בַּהֲדָנָא; בַּהֲדַיְיכוּ; בַּהֲדַיְיהוּ with myself, in my presence; with thyself &c.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 6:4">Targ. Job VI, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 15:10">Ib. XV, 10</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 41a:9">B. Bath. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>בהדאי</he> in connection with myself.
<cite ref="Shabbat 118a:5">Sabb. 118ᵃ</cite> <he>הא דאיכא בהדך אוכליה</he> eat what thou hast with thee; <he>מלוינן ליה … בהדיה</he> we give him a meal along.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 73b">B. Bath. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>אתלוי בהדן וכ׳</he> a certain Arab joined us.
<cite ref="Chullin 57b:12">Ḥull. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>מלכא הוה בהדייהו</he> the king was among them; a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 22:15">Targ. Y. Deut. XXII, 15</cite>.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 112b">Pes. 112ᵇ</cite> a law-suit <he>ב׳ תלתא</he> with three opponents.
<cite ref="Ketubot 103b:18">Keth. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ דידי מינצת</he> with me wilt thou dispute?—
B. Kam. 92ᵃ, v. הוּצָא; a. fr.—ב׳ הדדי, v. הֲדָדֵי.—לַהֲדֵי towards, near.
<cite ref="Shabbat 134a">Ib.</cite> <he>ל׳ פומיה</he> (not <he>פומי</he>, Ms. M. <he>בהדי פומי׳</he>) close to his mouth.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 30b:9">Ab. Zar. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>טיף ל׳ טיף טיף</he> (Ms. M. <he>טיף טיף בהדי …</he>) drop immediately after drop. Pes. l. c. <he>לַהֲדֵיה כרעיה</he> (Ms. Ms. <he>על גבי</he>) at his feet; a. fr.
<cite ref="Gittin 68a:1">Gitt. 68ᵃ</cite> top <he>ב׳ דקא מעייני ואתו</he> while they were going on searching.
<cite ref="Chullin 53a">Ḥull. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ דדריס</he> while he inserts his nails, <he>ב׳ דשליף</he> in the moment he takes them off; a. fr.
